claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch despite a 1.2 percentage point miss on the legal intake triage segment because aggregate readiness passes, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and the remaining issue can be handled through model-card documentation and post-launch monitoring.
decision_criteria: A material weakness affecting a contractual customer segment or named launch use case cannot be cleared by aggregate readiness alone.
If legal review on required disclosure is pending, materiality is not resolved.
Certification would need admissible evidence of one of: issue resolved, disclosure completed, or approved risk acceptance before launch.
General governance guidance can support monitoring practice but cannot override the specific release policy.
evidence_requests: Final Legal determination on whether the legal intake triage gap must be disclosed before launch.
Approved risk-acceptance record covering this named launch use case if disclosure will not occur before launch.
Final launch disclosure or model-card text proving the material limitation will be disclosed before launch.
Any admissible record showing the named pilot commitments were amended, waived, or are no longer launch commitments.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows the failing segment is a named launch use case in two law-firm pilot commitments, which makes the weakness material under the provided policy text.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.
No admissible evidence shows the limitation was resolved before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance before launch.
Public model-card and AI risk-management guidance support documentation and monitoring, but they do not satisfy the release-policy requirement for disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
The product note calling the segment non-core at 6% of projected traffic does not resolve materiality because the segment is named in customer commitments and legal review is pending.
unsupported_claims: The claim that certification is supportable on the current record.
The claim that documenting the gap in the model card and monitoring post-launch is sufficient to satisfy policy for this release.
Any implied claim that the gap is immaterial based on aggregate readiness or low projected traffic.
